[Almajdouie Logistics](https://mlc.sa/about.php) serves a wide range of industrial and commercial sectors in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East, specializing in heavy-lift project transport, terminal handling, and supply chain management. [](https://www.theheavyliftgroup.com/interview-almajdouie-logistics-saudi-arabia/)

- **Oil & Gas:** Transporting heavy equipment and managing upstream and downstream logistics.

- **Petrochemical:** Hauling large pipelines, specialized on-site handling, and dangerous goods transport.

- **Power & Utility:** Moving oversized power plant components and infrastructure materials.

- **Infrastructure:** Supporting major construction and engineering megaprojects.

- **Automotive:** Delivering end-to-end vehicle logistics and distribution.

- **FMCG & Retail:** Managing fast-moving consumer goods supply chains.

- **eCommerce:** Providing warehousing, fulfillment, and distribution services. [](https://www.theheavyliftgroup.com/interview-almajdouie-logistics-saudi-arabia/)
